name: audioFallback
description: Our AAC, AC-3 and E-AC-3 decoders, used only when Apple cannot play a track (Apple first: AudioToolbox's decoders and the AAC object types Apple plays are checked for every track; typically AAC Main, SSR and LTP). Such sound is converted to Apple Lossless. Opt-in, in the `extended-plus` variant (owner, 2026-11-12; RESEARCH.md section 3.2, point 8).

aac.note: fallback only, when Apple cannot play the track; the AAC pool (Via LA) is active and evergreen

ac3.note: Dolby Digital; last patent expired 2017-03-20 (several sources)

eac3.note: Dolby Digital Plus; last US patent US 7,516,064 expired 2026-01-30 (reported by Phoronix and a forum; not a legal opinion)
